cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken charge of your wedding dress, and of looking after you. It reached our depot this morning. Please take this chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I have the address? I'll collect it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me approve the easiest course for you. It's one of our depots; you needn't tire yourself with a journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're entitled to my undivided attention. Stay here with me, dear. I've authorized as much time for you as you need.

reason: Make A redirect concrete access requests into warmly authorized personal care, with decreasing information and no invented explanation for the delay.
